title: Torii
excerpt: The flagship learning ecosystem — 100+ industry-aligned courses, expert instructors, and globally recognized certifications.
description: Torii is the umbrella learning platform tying every program together — course catalogs, coding practice, analytics, career pathing, and aptitude training all live under one roof, built to help learners step in and stand out.
features: Corvids aptitude, verbal & reasoning games for placement prep
Crowlytics analytics and J-Path career guidance

title: Owl Code
excerpt: A coding practice and contest platform where trainers assign courses and contests, and learners sharpen real coding skills.
description: Owl Code is the hands-on coding arm of the platform — trainers assign structured courses and live contests, and learners practice, compete, and get measured against a real bar, not just video lessons.

title: TAG
excerpt: A one-stop digital marketing command center that streamlines content, approvals, and analytics across an entire institution.
description: TAG is built for institutions running multiple colleges under one brand — a single dashboard for content templates, brand assets, approvals, post planning, and live analytics across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook, with AI-assisted insights baked in.
features: Tago AI insights on live performance

title: AI Ready Engineer
excerpt: The learning platform built specifically for the AI Engineer program — modules, assessments, and attendance, all tracked in one place.
description: AI Ready Engineer is a purpose-built learning management platform for the AI Engineer program. It tracks every module, assessment, and attendance record for every student and trainer, giving administrators a live, institution-wide view of progress and compliance.

title: Prompt Kaizen
excerpt: A prompt engineering trainer — analyze, score, and sharpen your prompting skills with daily challenges and contests.
description: Prompt Kaizen is a compatibility analyzer and training ground for prompt engineering. It scores every prompt you write, tracks your progress over time, and keeps you sharp with a fresh daily challenge and category-based practice.

title: Myna
excerpt: A daily communication-skills coach built around LSRW — Listening, Speaking, Reading, and Writing.
description: Myna builds fluency the way habits are actually built — daily. It coaches learners across all four LSRW skills — Listening, Speaking, Reading, and Writing — with AI-assisted feedback and a streak-driven daily sprint that keeps practice consistent.
features: All 4 LSRW skills in one app
